title: Autonomous repo bugfix scan pass 2
summary: Fixed PowerShell unit validation drift found during an autonomous repo scan: repaired two repo-root resolvers, retargeted fallback-remux static guards after process-module splitting, added queue cleanup harness coverage, and isolated the synthetic nested rerun pipeline mutex.
reason: The full PowerShell unit sweep exposed validation failures caused by stale test contracts and environmental mutex collisions. These failures blocked the safe validation ladder without requiring production media-policy changes.
behavior_before: Several PowerShell unit checks failed under the current ops layout or a live external pipeline mutex: audit-score and robocopy tests resolved repo root as ops, library-profile routing checked thin wrappers instead of owner modules, queue-engine tests lacked the periodic cleanup dependency, and rerun nested-config tests could collide with an external controller lock.
behavior_after: PowerShell unit checks resolve the repository root correctly, fallback-remux static assertions follow the split owner modules, queue-round tests cover periodic cleanup through a local stub, and the rerun nested-config fixture uses an isolated test mutex while preserving the production lock behavior.
rollback_plan: Revert the five PowerShell unit-check edits and regenerate the matching summaries; no production media-processing code was changed.
notes:
Fix repo-root resolution in the audit score PowerShell unit check after ops layout migration.
Update fallback-remux static guard to follow the split process modules after entrypoint wrappers became thin adapters.
Add periodic local-encoded cleanup stub and assertions so queue engine unit rounds match production-loaded dependencies.
Isolate the synthetic nested rerun pipeline from external controller mutexes during unit validation.
Fix repo-root resolution for the robocopy progress telemetry PowerShell unit check after ops layout migration.
Refresh generated summary for changed PowerShell unit check.
Regenerate project index/dependency graph to satisfy AI guardrail postflight.
